To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the activity of C2 gene promoter is repressed by coexpressed C1+C2 ORFs, whereas the activity of the promoter of V1+V2 genes is enhanced by the coexpression of the V1+V1 and V2+V2 ORFs in tobacco protoplasts.
TobYDV promoter activity in N. clevelandi protoplast extract is regulated by the ORFs in a sequence-specific manner.
the promoter activities of TobYDV C1 and C2 genes are regulated by the C1 and C1+2 viral ORFs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the activity and regulation of the promoter from TobYDV.
the characterization of promoters from the TobYDV genome and regulation of their activities by the ORFs.
the identification of the promoters from TobYDV genome and their activity in different plants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
TobYDV promoters were active in both monocots and dicots.
the C1+C2 ORF promoter is the most powerful promoter among the three promoters from TobYDV and the C1+V2 ORF promoter the weakest one.
the promoter activities are dependent on the plant system used for the assay and on the expression of the ORF.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the promoters from TobYDV were active in both tobacco and maize.
the activity of the TobYDV promoter is regulated by its ORFs and the activity of the C1+C2 promoter is higher than the activity of V2 promoter in tobacco protoplasts.
the C1+C2 gene promoter was repressed by C1+C2 ORF, V1 and C2 ORFs were repressed by C2 ORF, whereas V1 and V3 ORFs were repressing V1 promoter.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the activity of the promoters is different from the expression of their corresponding ORFs.
the promoter of V1 and C2 genes are the most active promoters from TobYDV genome and the promoter of C2 gene was repressed by the C2 ORF in N. clevelandi protoplasts.
the promoters of TobYDV have a potential to be used for expression in plant protoplasts and in plants.
